summary: Prefix matching consumed one extra input byte after matching a special float literal, incorrectly accepting inputs such as inf1 and nan0. The fix checks whether the prefix iterator is exhausted before advancing the input iterator. The proposed reversal restores the case-insensitive bug verbatim. Blocked: detecting negative-format checks exist in data/test-parse-unittests/main.rs, but run through a standalone binary rather than a named Rust #[test]. No detecting named test was found at the fixed commit.
